title: Join streamed tool call fragments that carry no index

@@ -63,6 +63,16 @@ engine: the file chooser relay and the per-turn browser tokens are in the
   `connections.codex`, and the Codex card in Settings shows the machine's
   login instead of a key form. The default stays `:api_key`.
 
+### Fixed
+
+- **Streamed tool calls without an `index` are no longer split into
+  fragments.** OpenAI-compatible servers (Gemini's compatibility endpoint,
+  some Ollama and OpenRouter backends) stream tool calls without the `index`
+  that ties argument fragments to their call, and the Chat provider turned
+  every fragment into its own tool call with partial arguments. A fragment
+  now continues the call with the same `id`, or the last call when it has no
+  `id` and no function name.
+

+        # Finds the streamed tool call an unindexed delta continues
+        #
+        # OpenAI-compatible servers (Gemini's compatibility endpoint, some Ollama
+        # and OpenRouter backends) omit the `index` that ties argument fragments
+        # to their call. A delta carrying an `id` continues the call with that
+        # id; one without an id or a function name continues the last call;
+        # anything else starts a new call.
+        #
+        # @param tool_calls [Array<Hash>] calls accumulated so far
+        # @param delta_item [Hash] unindexed tool call delta
+        # @return [Hash, nil] the call to merge into, or nil for a new call
+        def unindexed_tool_call_target(tool_calls, delta_item)
+          if delta_item[:id].present?
+            tool_calls.find { _1[:id] == delta_item[:id] }
+          elsif delta_item.dig(:function, :name).blank?
+            tool_calls.last
+          end
+        end
+
+        # Strips the fields a server repeats on every fragment (`id`, `type`,
+        # the function name), so merging does not concatenate them.
+        #
+        # @param hash_item [Hash] the call the fragment continues
+        # @param delta_item [Hash] unindexed tool call delta
+        # @return [Hash] the fragment to merge
+        def unindexed_tool_call_fragment(hash_item, delta_item)
+          fragment = delta_item.except(:id, :type)
+          if fragment[:function].is_a?(Hash) && fragment.dig(:function, :name) == hash_item.dig(:function, :name)
+            fragment = fragment.merge(function: fragment[:function].except(:name))
+          end
+          fragment
+        end
+

+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+require "test_helper"
+
+begin
+  require "openai"
+rescue LoadError
+  puts "OpenAI gem not available, skipping OpenAI Chat streaming tool call tests"
+  return
+end
+
+require_relative "../../../../lib/active_agent/providers/open_ai/chat_provider"
+
+module Providers
+  module OpenAI
+    module Chat
+      # OpenAI-compatible servers (Gemini's compatibility endpoint, some Ollama
+      # and OpenRouter backends) stream tool calls without the `index` field the
+      # OpenAI API sends. Their deltas must still end up as the right calls.
+      class StreamingToolCallsTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
+        setup do
+          @provider = ActiveAgent::Providers::OpenAI::ChatProvider.new(
+            service: "OpenAI",
+            api_key: "test-key",
+            model: "gpt-5.6-terra",
+            messages: [ { role: "user", content: "Hello" } ],
+            stream_broadcaster: ->(message, delta, event_type) { }
+          )
+        end
+
+        def merge(*deltas)
+          message = { index: 0, role: "assistant" }
+          deltas.each { |delta| @provider.send(:message_merge_delta, message, delta) }
+          message
+        end
+
+        test "argument fragments without an index continue the call they follow" do
+          message = merge(
+            { tool_calls: [ { id: "call_1", type: "function", function: { name: "get_weather", arguments: "" } } ] },
+            { tool_calls: [ { function: { arguments: "{\"city\":" } } ] },
+            { tool_calls: [ { function: { arguments: "\"Boston\"}" } } ] }
+          )
+
+          assert_equal 1, message[:tool_calls].size
+          assert_equal "get_weather", message[:tool_calls][0][:function][:name]
+          assert_equal "{\"city\":\"Boston\"}", message[:tool_calls][0][:function][:arguments]
+        end
+
+        test "calls without an index are told apart by id" do
+          message = merge(
+            { tool_calls: [ { id: "call_1", type: "function", function: { name: "a", arguments: "{" } } ] },
+            { tool_calls: [ { id: "call_2", type: "function", function: { name: "b", arguments: "{" } } ] },
+            { tool_calls: [ { id: "call_1", function: { arguments: "}" } } ] }
+          )
+
+          assert_equal %w[a b], message[:tool_calls].map { _1[:function][:name] }
+          assert_equal %w[{} {], message[:tool_calls].map { _1[:function][:arguments] }
+        end
+
+        test "an id, type and name repeated on every fragment are not concatenated" do
+          call = ->(arguments) { { id: "call_1", type: "function", function: { name: "get_weather", arguments: } } }
+          message = merge(
+            { tool_calls: [ call.("") ] },
+            { tool_calls: [ call.("{\"city\":") ] },
+            { tool_calls: [ call.("\"Boston\"}") ] }
+          )
+
+          assert_equal 1, message[:tool_calls].size
+          assert_equal "call_1", message[:tool_calls][0][:id]
+          assert_equal "function", message[:tool_calls][0][:type]
+          assert_equal "get_weather", message[:tool_calls][0][:function][:name]
+          assert_equal "{\"city\":\"Boston\"}", message[:tool_calls][0][:function][:arguments]
+        end
+
+        test "complete calls without an index or id stay separate calls" do
+          message = merge(
+            { tool_calls: [ { type: "function", function: { name: "a", arguments: "{}" } },
+                            { type: "function", function: { name: "b", arguments: "{}" } } ] }
+          )
+
+          assert_equal %w[a b], message[:tool_calls].map { _1[:function][:name] }
+        end
+
+        test "indexed calls still merge by index" do
+          message = merge(
+            { tool_calls: [ { index: 0, id: "call_1", type: "function", function: { name: "a", arguments: "" } } ] },
+            { tool_calls: [ { index: 1, id: "call_2", type: "function", function: { name: "b", arguments: "" } } ] },
+            { tool_calls: [ { index: 0, function: { arguments: "{}" } } ] }
+          )
+
+          assert_equal %w[a b], message[:tool_calls].map { _1[:function][:name] }
+          assert_equal [ "{}", "" ], message[:tool_calls].map { _1[:function][:arguments] }
+        end
+      end
+    end
+  end
+end
